alt: 家長指著桌上的潑水提醒擦拭，少年聽見後仍轉過頭，繼續玩手邊的玩具。
scene_prompt: At a kitchen table a teenager continues playing with small toy pieces, deliberately turning their face away while a parent nearby speaks and clearly gestures toward a spilled cup that needs wiping. The teenager’s uncovered ears and sideways eye show they hear the reminder but choose to ignore it. A cloth lies beside the puddle. No headphones, speech bubbles or text; clear deliberate disregard of an audible request.
